description: reflect plugin hooks. SessionStart re-renders MEMORY.md as the activation-ranked hot tier so the auto-loaded index self-heals under the load budget (cheap, fail-open, write-skips when unchanged). UserPromptSubmit runs once-per-session seeded recall (qmd vsearch, fail-safe — never blocks the prompt, exits 0 on any error/timeout/absence). PostToolUse + PreToolUse fire the reflect-trigger flag at completion boundaries (PR create/merge, ExitPlanMode, all-todos-done) so /reflect runs its hygiene pass. All hooks fail-open and exit 0; hook arrays merge additively with the user's settings and other plugins. Paths resolve via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.

hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'gh pr (create|merge)'; then "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/reflect-trigger.sh" PR_event; fi

if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '"status":"completed"' && ! echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '"status":"(pending|in_progress)"'; then "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/reflect-trigger.sh" TodoWrite_all_done; fi
